name: cloudinary
label: Cloudinary
description: Cloudinary is a cloud-based image and video management platform that allows you to upload, store, manage, and deliver your media assets. It provides a range of features for image and video optimization, transformation, and delivery.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: Your Cloudinary API Key. Found in Console Settings → API Keys page.

api_secret.label: API Secret
api_secret.description: Your Cloudinary API Secret. Found in Console Settings → API Keys page. Keep this secure and never share publicly.

cloud_name.label: Cloud Name
cloud_name.description: Your Cloudinary Cloud Name. Found in Console Settings → API Keys page or in your dashboard URL (e.g., "demo" from console.cloudinary.com/console/demo).

cloudinary_create_folder.label: Create Folder
cloudinary_create_folder.description: Creates an empty folder, including any missing parent folders.

cloudinary_create_image_from_text.label: Create Image from Text
cloudinary_create_image_from_text.description: Renders text as a new PNG image asset.

public_id.label: Public ID
public_id.description: Public ID for the new image. Leave empty for a random ID.

font_size.label: Font Size
font_size.description: Font size in points. Defaults to 12.

font_color.label: Font Color
font_color.description: Color name or hex (e.g. "red", "#FF0000"). Defaults to black.

background.label: Background
background.description: Background color name or hex. Defaults to transparent.

cloudinary_create_multi_resource.label: Create Animation from Images
cloudinary_create_multi_resource.description: Combines images into an animated GIF, a video or a multi-page PDF.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: Combine all images with this tag. Use either this or URLs.

urls.label: Image URLs
urls.description: Ordered Cloudinary delivery URLs of the images. Use either this or Tag.

format.label: Output Format
format.description: The output file type. Defaults to gif.

async.label: Process Asynchronously
async.description: Return immediately and generate in the background.

cloudinary_create_transformation.label: Create Named Transformation
cloudinary_create_transformation.description: Saves a transformation under a reusable name.

name.label: Transformation Name
name.description: Named transformation name, without the t_ prefix.

allowed_for_strict.label: Allowed for Strict Mode
allowed_for_strict.description: Allow this transformation when strict transformations are enabled.

cloudinary_delete_metadata_field.label: Delete Metadata Field
cloudinary_delete_metadata_field.description: Deletes a structured metadata field and its values on all assets.

external_id.label: Field External ID
external_id.description: The metadata field external_id, from List Metadata Fields.

cloudinary_delete_resources_by_tag.label: Delete Resources by Tag
cloudinary_delete_resources_by_tag.description: Permanently deletes all assets of one resource type that carry a tag.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: The exact tag whose assets will be deleted.

keep_original.label: Keep Original
keep_original.description: Delete only derived versions and keep the original files.

invalidate.label: Invalidate CDN Cache
invalidate.description: Also invalidate cached copies on the CDN (takes a few minutes to propagate).

cloudinary_delete_resources.label: Delete Resources
cloudinary_delete_resources.description: Permanently deletes assets by public IDs or by public ID prefix.

type.label: Delivery Type
type.description: The storage/delivery type of the asset. Defaults to upload.

public_ids.label: Public IDs
public_ids.description: Up to 100 public IDs to delete. Use either this or Prefix.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Delete every asset whose public ID starts with this value. Use either this or Public IDs.

keep_original.label: Keep Original
keep_original.description: Delete only derived versions and keep the original files.

invalidate.label: Invalidate CDN Cache
invalidate.description: Also invalidate cached copies on the CDN (takes a few minutes to propagate).

name.label: Transformation Name
name.description: Named transformation name, without the t_ prefix.

invalidate.label: Invalidate CDN Cache
invalidate.description: Also invalidate cached copies on the CDN (takes a few minutes to propagate).

cloudinary_destroy_asset_by_id.label: Destroy Asset by Asset ID
cloudinary_destroy_asset_by_id.description: Permanently deletes one asset by its immutable asset ID.

invalidate.label: Invalidate CDN Cache
invalidate.description: Also invalidate cached copies on the CDN (takes a few minutes to propagate).

cloudinary_explicit_resource.label: Apply Operations to Resource
cloudinary_explicit_resource.description: Runs upload-time operations (eager transformations, tags, context, metadata) on an existing asset.

type.label: Delivery Type
type.description: The storage/delivery type of the asset. Defaults to upload.

eager_async.label: Generate Asynchronously
eager_async.description: Generate eager transformations in the background (recommended for videos).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Replaces the asset's tags with this list.

context.label: Context
context.description: Contextual metadata as pipe-separated key=value pairs.

invalidate.label: Invalidate CDN Cache
invalidate.description: Also invalidate cached copies on the CDN (takes a few minutes to propagate).

cloudinary_get_config.label: Get Environment Config
cloudinary_get_config.description: Gets the product environment configuration, such as the folder mode.

cloudinary_get_metadata_field.label: Get Metadata Field
cloudinary_get_metadata_field.description: Gets one structured metadata field definition.

external_id.label: Field External ID
external_id.description: The metadata field external_id, from List Metadata Fields.

cloudinary_get_resource_by_asset_id.label: Get Resource by Asset ID
cloudinary_get_resource_by_asset_id.description: Gets the full details of one asset by its immutable asset ID.

include_colors.label: Include Colors
include_colors.description: Include the predominant colors and color histogram (images only).

include_media_metadata.label: Include Media Metadata
include_media_metadata.description: Include IPTC, XMP and detailed Exif metadata.

include_quality_analysis.label: Include Quality Analysis
include_quality_analysis.description: Include the quality analysis score (images only).

include_versions.label: Include Versions
include_versions.description: Include backed-up versions of the asset, when backups are enabled.

cloudinary_get_resource.label: Get Resource
cloudinary_get_resource.description: Gets the full details of one asset by its public ID.

type.label: Delivery Type
type.description: The storage/delivery type of the asset. Defaults to upload.

public_id.label: Public ID
public_id.description: The asset's public ID, without file extension for images and videos (e.g. "products/shoe").

include_colors.label: Include Colors
include_colors.description: Include the predominant colors and color histogram (images only).

include_media_metadata.label: Include Media Metadata
include_media_metadata.description: Include IPTC, XMP and detailed Exif metadata.

include_quality_analysis.label: Include Quality Analysis
include_quality_analysis.description: Include the quality analysis score (images only).

include_versions.label: Include Versions
include_versions.description: Include backed-up versions of the asset, when backups are enabled.

cloudinary_get_transformation.label: Get Transformation
cloudinary_get_transformation.description: Gets a transformation's definition and the assets derived with it.

name.label: Transformation
name.description: A named transformation name, or a transformation string (e.g. "c_fill,w_200").

cloudinary_get_upload_preset.label: Get Upload Preset
cloudinary_get_upload_preset.description: Gets one upload preset's settings by name.

cloudinary_get_usage.label: Get Usage
cloudinary_get_usage.description: Gets account usage and plan limits: storage, bandwidth, transformations, requests and credits.

date.label: Date
date.description: Day to report, as YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 3 months. Leave empty for the latest figures.

cloudinary_get_video_views.label: Get Video Views
cloudinary_get_video_views.description: Gets video view analytics from the Cloudinary Video Player.

sort_by.label: Sort By
sort_by.description: Sort order. Defaults to most recent view first.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_metadata_fields.label: List Metadata Fields
cloudinary_list_metadata_fields.description: Lists the structured metadata field definitions.

external_ids.label: External IDs
external_ids.description: Only return these fields. Leave empty for all.

cloudinary_list_resource_types.label: List Resource Types
cloudinary_list_resource_types.description: Lists the resource types (image, video, raw) that exist in the product environment.

cloudinary_list_resources_by_asset_folde.label: List Resources by Asset Folder
cloudinary_list_resources_by_asset_folde.description: Lists the assets stored in an asset folder.

resource_type.label: Resource Type
resource_type.description: The asset type. Leave empty to include all types.

direction.label: Sort Direction
direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_resources_by_context.label: List Resources by Context
cloudinary_list_resources_by_context.description: Lists assets that have a contextual metadata key, optionally with a specific value.

key.label: Context Key
key.description: The contextual metadata key to match (e.g. "alt", "caption").

value.label: Context Value
value.description: Only return assets where the key has exactly this value. Leave empty to match any value.

direction.label: Sort Direction
direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_resources_by_tag.label: List Resources by Tag
cloudinary_list_resources_by_tag.description: Lists assets of one resource type that carry a given tag.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: The exact tag to match. Use List Tags to find existing tags.

direction.label: Sort Direction
direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

include_metadata.label: Include Structured Metadata
include_metadata.description: Include each asset's structured metadata values.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_resources_in_moderation.label: List Resources in Moderation
cloudinary_list_resources_in_moderation.description: Lists assets by moderation type and status.

direction.label: Sort Direction
direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_resources.label: List Resources
cloudinary_list_resources.description: Lists assets of one resource type and delivery type, optionally filtered by public ID prefix.

type.label: Delivery Type
type.description: The storage/delivery type of the asset. Defaults to upload.

prefix.label: Public ID Prefix
prefix.description: Only return assets whose public ID starts with this value (e.g. "products/").

start_at.label: Start At
start_at.description: Only return assets created after this ISO 8601 date-time. Cannot be combined with Next Cursor.

direction.label: Sort Direction
direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

include_metadata.label: Include Structured Metadata
include_metadata.description: Include each asset's structured metadata values.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_root_folders.label: List Root Folders
cloudinary_list_root_folders.description: Lists the top-level folders of the media library.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_subfolders.label: List Subfolders
cloudinary_list_subfolders.description: Lists the direct subfolders of a folder.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_tags.label: List Tags
cloudinary_list_tags.description: Lists the tags used on assets of one resource type.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Only return tags starting with this value.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_transformations.label: List Transformations
cloudinary_list_transformations.description: Lists transformations used in the account, optionally only named ones.

named.label: Named Only
named.description: Yes for named transformations only, No for unnamed only. Leave empty to keep the default.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_list_upload_presets.label: List Upload Presets
cloudinary_list_upload_presets.description: Lists the upload presets defined in the account.

max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor

cloudinary_order_metadata_datasource.label: Sort Metadata Field Values
cloudinary_order_metadata_datasource.description: Sorts the allowed values of an enum or set metadata field.

external_id.label: Field External ID
external_id.description: The metadata field external_id, from List Metadata Fields.

cloudinary_rename_folder.label: Rename Folder
cloudinary_rename_folder.description: Renames or moves a folder, together with all its assets and subfolders.

cloudinary_rename_resource.label: Rename Resource
cloudinary_rename_resource.description: Changes an asset's public ID, optionally moving it to another delivery type.

type.label: Delivery Type
type.description: The storage/delivery type of the asset. Defaults to upload.

to_type.label: New Delivery Type
to_type.description: Move the asset to this delivery type. Leave empty to keep it.

overwrite.label: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace an existing asset that already has the new public ID.

invalidate.label: Invalidate CDN Cache
invalidate.description: Also invalidate cached copies on the CDN (takes a few minutes to propagate).

cloudinary_reorder_metadata_field.label: Move Metadata Field
cloudinary_reorder_metadata_field.description: Moves one metadata field to a position in the field list.

external_id.label: Field External ID
external_id.description: The metadata field external_id, from List Metadata Fields.

cloudinary_reorder_metadata_fields.label: Sort Metadata Fields
cloudinary_reorder_metadata_fields.description: Sorts all metadata fields by label, creation date or external ID.

cloudinary_search_assets.label: Search Assets
cloudinary_search_assets.description: Searches assets with a Cloudinary search expression.

expression.label: Expression
expression.description: Search expression (e.g. "resource_type:image AND tags:sale"). Leave empty to match all assets.

sort_by.label: Sort By Field
sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g. "created_at", "public_id", "bytes"). Defaults to relevance, then created_at.

sort_direction.label: Sort Direction
sort_direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

with_field.label: Include Fields
with_field.description: Extra data to return for each asset.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_search_folders.label: Search Folders
cloudinary_search_folders.description: Searches folders by name, path or creation date.

expression.label: Expression
expression.description: Search expression (e.g. "name:banners"). Leave empty to list all folders.

sort_direction.label: Sort Direction
sort_direction.description: Sort by creation time. Defaults to newest first.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500). Defaults to 10.

next_cursor.label: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

cloudinary_search_metadata_field_datasou.label: Search Metadata Field Values
cloudinary_search_metadata_field_datasou.description: Searches the allowed values of one enum or set metadata field.

external_id.label: Field External ID
external_id.description: The metadata field external_id, from List Metadata Fields.

term.label: Search Term
term.description: Text to match in the values.

exact_match.label: Exact Match
exact_match.description: Only return values equal to the term.

cloudinary_update_resource_by_asset_id.label: Update Resource by Asset ID
cloudinary_update_resource_by_asset_id.description: Updates an asset's display name, folder, tags, context, structured metadata or moderation status by asset ID.

asset_folder.label: Asset Folder
asset_folder.description: Move the asset to this folder (dynamic folder mode).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Replaces ALL existing tags with this list. To add or remove single tags use Update Resource Tags.

context.label: Context
context.description: Replaces contextual metadata, as pipe-separated key=value pairs (e.g. "alt=Red shoe|caption=Summer").

metadata.label: Structured Metadata
metadata.description: Structured metadata values keyed by field external_id. Only the given fields change.

moderation_status.label: Moderation Status
moderation_status.description: Approve or reject an asset in manual moderation.

cloudinary_update_resource.label: Update Resource
cloudinary_update_resource.description: Updates an asset's display name, folder, tags, context, structured metadata or moderation status by public ID.

type.label: Delivery Type
type.description: The storage/delivery type of the asset. Defaults to upload.

asset_folder.label: Asset Folder
asset_folder.description: Move the asset to this folder (dynamic folder mode).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Replaces ALL existing tags with this list. To add or remove single tags use Update Resource Tags.

context.label: Context
context.description: Replaces contextual metadata, as pipe-separated key=value pairs (e.g. "alt=Red shoe|caption=Summer").

metadata.label: Structured Metadata
metadata.description: Structured metadata values keyed by field external_id. Only the given fields change.

moderation_status.label: Moderation Status
moderation_status.description: Approve or reject an asset in manual moderation.

cloudinary_update_transformation.label: Update Named Transformation
cloudinary_update_transformation.description: Changes a named transformation's definition or strict-mode flag.

name.label: Transformation Name
name.description: Named transformation name, without the t_ prefix.

allowed_for_strict.label: Allowed for Strict Mode
allowed_for_strict.description: Allow this transformation when strict transformations are enabled. Leave empty to keep the default.

cloudinary_upload_asset.label: Upload Asset
cloudinary_upload_asset.description: Uploads a file to Cloudinary from a public URL or a data URI.

file.label: File URL or Data URI
file.description: A publicly reachable URL of the file, or a data URI (data:image/png;base64,...).

public_id.label: Public ID
public_id.description: Public ID to assign (without extension). Leave empty for a random ID.

asset_folder.label: Asset Folder
asset_folder.description: Folder to place the asset in (e.g. "marketing/banners").

display_name.label: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the Media Library.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to add to the asset.

context.label: Context
context.description: Contextual metadata as pipe-separated key=value pairs (e.g. "alt=Red shoe|caption=Summer").

upload_preset.label: Upload Preset
upload_preset.description: Name of an upload preset to apply. List Upload Presets returns the names.

overwrite.label: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace an existing asset with the same Public ID. Leave empty to keep the default.

use_filename.label: Use Original Filename
use_filename.description: Use the source file name as the public ID (when Public ID is empty).
